<b>Борьба.</b> Полоска выскальзывает — и: Struggle. A bar slips away — the player presses space or clicks to hold it. Filled it up — one scene, too late — another. This is how the game rescues from the meat grinder.
<b>В игру.</b> Дальше идёт оригинальная: Into the game. Next comes the original story of «Tiny Bunny» from the given label. Labels are in the game's scripts (for example d4_begin).
<b>Выбор.</b> Игрок видит варианты и выб:
Choice. The player sees the options and picks one — the story goes to the scene the arrow points to.

Edit an option's text right in the card. To reorder, drag an option by the dots on the left. Pick the target scene with the arrow: you can create a new one right there.

Glowing spots on the picture — a choice like in the game itself («TAKE / REFUSE»): glowing spots with words appear on the scene, and a spot brightens under the mouse. Turn it on in the card and place the spots on the preview: on a candy in a hand, on a door, on a face.
<b>Достижение.</b> В углу выезжает кубок: Achievement. A trophy with its title slides in at the corner. Each one — once and forever: the «Mods» menu shows how many are collected.
<b>Загадка.</b> Игрок вписывает ответ на: Riddle. The player writes the answer on a sheet of paper. There can be several right answers — separated by «/»; case and «ё» do not matter. Guessed — one scene, not — another.
<b>Заметка.</b> Видна только тебе, в игр: Note. Only you can see it; it never gets into the game.
<b>Записка.</b> Лист бумаги с нацарапанн: Note on paper. A sheet of paper with scrawled words — it stays on screen until the player clicks. A threat in the mailbox, a cheat sheet, a letter.
<b>Камень-ножницы-бумага.</b> Игрок выби: Rock-paper-scissors. The player picks a sign, the hands shake three times — and who won. A draw — they play again. Pick whose hands the opponent plays with, and where: «here» — the scene itself in a haze, or one of the places by day, evening or night. Won and lost — two different scenes.
<b>Камера.</b> Так «Зайчик» оживляет неп:
Camera. This is how «Tiny Bunny» brings still pictures to life: the whole frame moves — the background and everyone on it.

Zoom in and close-up — the camera moves to a point: place it on the preview (the circle with a crosshair), on a face or a door.
Steps, running — the hero walks or runs. Breathing, heartbeat, trembling, swaying — the mood of the frame.

The motion lasts until a «Camera: stop» card or a new background. Click the preview to play it again.
<b>Кнопка.</b> История останавливается и: Button. The story stops and waits until the player presses a button with your words.
<b>Код.</b> Одна строка на Python — для: Code. One line of Python — for those who know the game's code. For example, change a variable of the game. A mistake here can crash the game.
<b>Конец.</b> Музыка стихает, на чёрном: The end. The music fades, «The End» appears on black, and the game returns to the main menu.
<b>Надпись.</b> Крупные буквы посреди эк: Big words. Big letters in the middle of the screen for a few seconds: «Day five», «A year later», «Tell no one».
<b>Назад в игру.</b> Конец вставки: игра: Back to the game. The end of an insert: the game goes on from where the mod interrupted it. Needed at the end of every scene inserted with @вставка.
<b>Осмотр.</b> На картинке светятся точк: Look around. Spots glow on the picture: the player points and clicks. «Look» — show a line of description and go back to looking. «Exit» — go to another scene. At least one exit is needed, or there is no way out.
<b>Пазл.</b> Картинка рвётся на куски и: Puzzle. The picture is torn into pieces scattered over the table from the minigame with Polina's poster. The player drags the pieces — at its place a piece clicks in. All in — the story goes to the scene the arrow points to. It can be solved at once with the button in the corner.
<b>Пауза.</b> Ничего не происходит — сек: Pause. Nothing happens — a second of silence before an important line.
<b>Переход.</b> История продолжается в д: Jump. The story continues in another scene. Without a jump, a scene that reaches its end ends the mod.
<b>Плёнка.</b> Девяностые: картинка как:
Tape. The ’90s: the picture looks like a worn-out VHS tape — stripes, colour fringes, a crawling glitch. Or TV «snow». It stays until you set «normal»: good for memories, dreams, camera footage.

TV — the scene plays on the screen of the old TV from the game itself. Memory — the frame and scratches of old film: this is how the game shows the past.
<b>Погода.</b> Снег из самой игры поверх: Weather. Snow from the game itself over the scene. It falls until a new background: a new background is a clean frame.
<b>Предмет в руке.</b> Снизу поднимается: Item in hand. Anton's hand rises from below holding a photo card with any picture of the game — like the gum insert. It stays until the player clicks.
<b>Снимок.</b> Антон поднимает полароид,: Snapshot. Anton raises the polaroid, a flash — and a card with this very frame and your caption appears. Like in episode three.
<b>Счётчик.</b> Мод помнит числа: смелос: Counter. The mod remembers numbers: courage, friendship with Polina, how many candies you took. «Change» adds or subtracts, «Condition» later checks how much has piled up and leads to the right scene.
<b>Телефон.</b> Тот самый кнопочный теле: Phone. The very push-button phone from episode five. The player dials the number themselves: each number leads to its own scene. A wrong number — the operator says so, or send it to a scene of yours. Hint the numbers beforehand: in a note, on a poster, in a line.
<b>Титры.</b> Строчки плывут снизу вверх: Credits. Lines float up over a black screen. Each line is its own line of the credits. A click skips them.
<b>Условие.</b> Если счётчик набрал нужн: Condition. If the counter has reached the value, the story goes to the scene the arrow points to. If not, it goes on through the cards.
<b>Эпилог.</b> Страница концовки, как в: Epilogue. An ending page, as in the game itself: the art of one of the endings (or the scene darkened), a heading, text and a button. Put it before «The End».
<b>Эту строку мод не понимает.</b> Попра: The mod does not understand this line. Fix its text in the card or remove the card with the cross.
<b>Эффект.</b> Срабатывает в этот момент: Effect. Triggers at this moment of the story.
